interpretation: Aristotle's reason why a thing is moved just when the actuality of the potential is present, neither before nor after: 'for each thing can be active at one time and not at another, as the buildable' (ἐνδέχεται γὰρ ἕκαστον ὁτὲ μὲν ἐνεργεῖν ὁτὲ δὲ μή, οἷον τὸ οἰκοδομητόν). The buildable's activity qua buildable is building (201b9-15, ARIST-PHYS-201B-BUILDABLE-IS-BUILDING-A), so a buildable not being built is in potency to the house without being moved toward it. Read in the case's vocabulary (InPotency; MovedIn as reduction, DISAMB-MOTION), indexed by situations: in some situation, some being is in potency in a respect and is not being moved in it. The modal and temporal 'can ... at one time ... at another not' is kept as quantification over situations; the reading does not assert an inactive potency in any particular situation, in particular not in the one the case's premises describe (that is the unattributed STMT-SOME-POTENCY-NOT-BEING-ACTUALIZED). It says nothing of every potential and gives no cause of the inactivity.
